mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skin_vote ( vote_id, winner_id, loser_id, vote_time ) VALUES ( seq_skin_vote.NEXTVAL, #{winnerId}, #{loserId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(win) AS winCount, SUM(lose) AS loseCount FROM ( SELECT winner_id AS user_id, 1 AS win, 0 AS lose FROM skin_vote UNION ALL SELECT loser_id AS user_id, 0 AS win, 1 AS lose FROM skin_vote ) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY winCount DESC
